text:
Aisha: Heads-up: last-minute speaker swap for tonight's all-hands  Jen will take the roadmap slot, Kevin moves to demos. Start time unchanged.
Kevin: OK, noted. I'll rehearse my demo in the prep room 10m early.
Jen: Got it. Can Product send me the 2-slide roadmap highlights so I dont miss anything?
Aisha: Sent in a DM. Also Ops requested presenters with demos to join 12m early for input mapping.
Priya: Quick recording question: can we enable 'seg-seal-on-transition' so we don't lose the tail of demos when slide decks swap?
Evan: Yes. Deploying a small patch now. Recorder will seal segments on slide-change events.
OpsBot: deploy: seg_seal_on_transition=true applied to all-hands cluster. status=OK (3.1s)
RecorderBot: recorder: enabling dual_persist(local,s3) and seg_seal. OK
Maya: Presenters: please do a mic test in the prep room and say "redwood mic demo check" when you join.
Kevin: redwood mic demo check
Maya: Got you loud and clear.
Priya: Leadership note: we'll keep a 7-min live Q&A after roadmap. If we run over, drop the rest of your Qs in this thread and we'll answer asynchronously.
Jen: Can we also capture a short follow-up doc for customers on model prioritization? I'll coordinate with Product after the meeting.
Aisha: Good plan. Jen, if you want the Product bullets now they're in the DM.
Evan: Ops tip in case of buffering: soft restart the recorder pod: `kubectl -n recorder rollout restart deploy/recorder` then ping #eng-sre. Avoid full host restarts during the meeting.
Priya: Note for presenters: disable "Share computer sound" in slide share. Use the DeckAudio input we provisioned. Duplicate streams break stitching.
OpsBot: preflight check: recorder-0 cpu=17% mem=50% disk=61% jitter=3ms segments_ok
RecorderBot: storage: s3_atomic_persist=enabled for session 1766007777
Jen: One more  my roadmap has a 20s embedded clip. Any special instructions?
Evan: Flag it in the prep room and we'll temporarily bump stream bitrate for you during that clip.
Maya: I'll coordinate the bitrate bump and mappings. Presenters with embedded audio/video DM me the timestamps.
Kevin: Also, if anyone needs a post-meeting clip extracted, Ops can stitch and push a trimmed MP4 to S3. DM me the timestamps.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. Drop urgent leadership Qs here and we'll surface them live. We'll capture any unanswered items and publish a follow-up thread with links to recordings and the customer-facing note. See you shortly :slightly_smiling_face:
